integrity: Explicit deterministic finite face/matching enumeration with complete acyclicity and exact integral Morse boundary tests; independent mod-two boundary reduction is a cross-check, not an integral proof.
scientific_limitations: Classification only for six finite graphs (1<=n<=6); no claim for n>=7, no asymptotic extrapolation or broader parameter class. Potential unindexed literature overlap remains.
title: The first mixed-dimensional two-independence complex in the three-row rook sequence
